import sys, httpcore
import openai
from openai.cli import _cli
captured = {}
orig = _cli._parse_args
def fake_parse(parser):
    parsed, args, unknown = orig(parser)
    parsed.func = lambda *a, **k: captured.setdefault("client", openai.http_client)
    args.args_model = None
    return parsed, args, unknown
_cli._parse_args = fake_parse
sys.argv = ["openai", "--proxy", "http://proxy.example:8080", "--organization", "org-x", "api", "models.list"]
rc = _cli.main()
assert rc == 0, rc
cl = captured["client"]
pools = [t._pool for t in cl._mounts.values() if t is not None]
assert any(isinstance(p, httpcore.HTTPProxy) and p._proxy_url.host == b"proxy.example" for p in pools), pools
print("OK cli proxied")
